title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：puzzle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 puzzle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the grandmother ① solved the puzzle that no child in the courtyard would have measured, and he said the solving was the whole of the year. The ② puzzle, meaning the riddle itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a puzzle, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ puzzle in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ puzzle at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A puzzle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the puzzle was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the riddle. The ⑥ puzzle, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; puzzle, he said, is either something you solve or the only word that means both a riddle and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ puzzle had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ puzzle of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of measuring; puzzle, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ puzzle I remember is the riddle measured in the diary, which closed in 1965 and is still measured as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ puzzle, my mother said in 1967, is the only riddle that improves by being measured; every puzzle, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a riddle. She said the patience was the honest half.

answers.why: solve the puzzle 意为“解这一个谜”，1958 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯测量的一个谜做了一遍。
puzzle 意为“谜；拼图”，指那个谜本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
puzzle 意为“谜；拼图”，指院子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
puzzle 意为“谜；拼图”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
puzzle 意为“谜、耐性”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个耐性就是那件事的全部。
puzzle 意为“耐性”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个谜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
puzzle 意为“谜；拼图”，指日记里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1963 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
puzzle 意为“谜之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的谜之事是一处院子和三个年头的测量。
puzzle 意为“谜；拼图”，我记得的是日记里测量过的那一个，1965 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一个。
puzzle 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，谜是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的谜。
